admissionOrder: Parse once: reject duplicate decoded keys, invalid Unicode, unsupported numbers/limits and invalid request schema. Authenticate current origin before revealing ledger results.
Resolve exact supported contract/schema/profile/mapping and verify origin bound to the qualified initiating Tagger representation and requested operation.

In exact appointed allocator namespace: lookup (Tagger issuer, local ID, logicalOperationKey). Existing same complete canonical request digest returns immutable historical receipt; different digest refuses HANDOFF_CONFLICT.

For unseen key: resolve exact definition bytes/reference/digest and assignmentRef bytes; validate catalogue, duplicated context fields, explicit sport mapping, competent applicability/effectivity/standing, policy and allocator scope.

Lock/serialize Tagger correspondence and expected assignment revision. If already resolved: use the same occurrence; different expected occurrence refuses CANONICAL_MISMATCH. Never allocate independently in Hub.
CREATE_OR_RESOLVE: one secure UUIDv4 only if representation has no applicable mapping; existing representation with different assignment requires CORRECT_SETUP, not silent reinterpretation.
CORRECT_SETUP: exact canonical/prior assignment/revision, no governed activation/activity; same occurrence, new setup/assignment revision and closure activity. Otherwise refuse without changes.

Atomic recoverable commit: allocation/non-reuse ledger when new, Tagger resolution, Capture resolution when created, exact setup/assignment acceptance/context, material result activity and logical operation receipt. Acknowledge only declared durable level.
boundary: NEW APPLICATION CONTRACT, NOT a revision of the Clock Authority Contract
effectivityRule: Effective for W1 DEVELOPMENT / CONFORMANCE at the verified Owner-authorised atomic publication revision; no invented date or containing hash
firstPilot: CONFORMANCE / PROPOSED ONLY: Gaelic football training, four fifteen-minute regulation quarters, no extra time; not appointed or operationally effective.

idempotency.durableOutbox: Hub writes local representation, setup, logical operation key, immutable request bytes/digest and pending standing before first send. Retry resends exact bytes/key; never generates a new timestamp/key.
idempotency.fingerprint: SHA-256 of ENTIRE canonical request, no excluded members. Timestamp/activity/build/context refs immutable across retries. Transport headers are outside the request.
idempotency.namespace: exact appointed allocator/issuer context + exact Tagger issuer/localId + durable logicalOperationKey
idempotency.privacy: Retain necessary permissible operation digest/result/non-reuse evidence under applicable policy. If closure no longer permits safe replay/resolution, refuse/withhold; do not guess or allocate anew.
idempotency.replay: Same result IDs/context/activity/receipt; delivery status DUPLICATE_HISTORICAL. No new allocation/activity/history/order consumption; receipt is not fresh appointment or clock authority.
idempotency.secondaryUniqueness: An issuer-qualified Tagger representation cannot acquire another canonical occurrence just because it arrives under another operation key.
idempotency.uncertainty: Indeterminate commit does not assert no mutation. Recover/query/retry same operation under ledger evidence; never allocate from transport failure.

immutableReferences: All references include exact id/version/sha256. Full format and assignment bytes verified; no latest/default/standard-GAA fallback.
implementationAuthorisation: NONE conveyed by this specification or its publication
operationalApplicability: NOT established by publication; exact real format, issuer/allocator, principal/grant, policy and deployment applicability required before corresponding real use
response: Exact response shape is schema $defs/response; Capture resolution required when representation created. Success is durable allocation/resolution/context acceptance, never clock activation.
safety: Definite refusal leaves allocation, correspondence, setup, governed clock/history/order and checkpoint unchanged; policy-controlled diagnostic/security logging is not material domain mutation.
statusRule: Controlled specification on competent Owner-authorised verified publication; candidate before that event
title: Tagger Hub → Capture Match Setup Handoff Contract

transport.authentication: Applicable authenticated origin channel + exact issuer/operation scope proof. No Hub self-appointment or unauthenticated identity text.
transport.responseRules: Application status is authoritative; HTTP codes are transport adapters. 200 success, 4xx definite refusal, 503 indeterminate/temporarily unavailable; lost response is NOT evidence of refusal.
